description: Get event counts and breakdowns for a date range (e.g., "2024-01-01" to "2024-01-31"). Returns frequency, user segments, and trends by event name.

event_type.description: EXACT event name as registered in the Amplitude project (case-sensitive). Do NOT guess or invent names — use the user-provided event name verbatim. Amplitude rejects unknown events with a 400.
